why: Mail scan, Monday 15:00 Jakarta: INSEAD confirmed his Business Foundations registration

notes.itemTitle: Decide on Business Foundations and register
notes.title: Registered for Business Foundations
notes.text: Celine Chin has confirmed your place on Business Foundations, 16 to 20 November online, so I have moved the task off waiting on the loan. The 1,530 euro fee still has to reach INSEAD by 30 October by bank transfer, and her email carries the details. - The transfer is the only part left.
